pages.title: Role in Progression
pages.text: Special and general techniques are not bound to one realm. They cover universal secrets, Divine Spirit Treasures, puppet mechanisms, insect control, spirit markings, ghost-path soul arts, demonic mind control, curses, and formations, and can be integrated gradually by source, realm, and system.

pages.title: General Arts and Artifacts
pages.text: Infusion Art forcibly channels spiritual power into a person, beast, or artifact, granting unstable strength. Great Spirit-Sealing Art can seal memory or spiritual awareness. Spirit-Treasure Formula drives Divine Spirit Treasures, whose full power requires mastery of the matching formula.

pages.title: Mechanisms, Insects, and Spirit Marks
pages.text: Puppet Mechanism Art covers material selection, rune engraving, and spiritual-awareness infusion. Insect Driving Art commands spirit insects for scouting or combat; Insect-Raising Insights records breeding methods; and Spirit-Marking Art inscribes the body to strengthen poison arts or grant special abilities.

pages.title: Soul Arts, Demonic Arts, and Curses
pages.text: Soul-Condensing, Soul-Refining, and Soul-Enticing Arts form the ghost path's foundation for manipulating souls. Mind-Control Art imposes mental restraints on mortals and is a demonic evil art. Spoken-Curse Art uses language as its medium and suits future status-effect and ritual systems.

pages.title: Formations and Reincarnation
pages.text: The Grand Yin-Fire Formation refines souls in ghostly flame and is a signature Ghost Spirit Sect formation. The Lesser Five Elements Sumeru Prohibition seals a small region of space. Yin-Yang Reincarnation Art explores the mysteries of life and death and may later connect the supreme ghost path to revival, rebirth, or reincarnation systems.
